entry_schema.title: item title at processing time
entry_schema.processed_at: time the repository transaction became canonical
entry_schema.curated_paths: array of authoritative knowledge or memory paths changed
entry_schema.theme_paths: array of existing approved theme paths linked

rules: Do not select a recorded provider item automatically again.
Record an item only after its complete authorised transaction is canonical.
Do not record inaccessible, unreadable or failed items as processed.
Reprocess a recorded item only after an explicit request identifies it.
